description: This file defines an internal object 'DeviceAuthPayload' that constructs an authentication payload string (version 'v3') with device-related metadata, including functions to build the payload and normalize metadata fields.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string by concatenating various device and user parameters, including normalized platform and device family strings.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a string metadata field by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase for consistency within auth payload.
